cmp_role.text: You design an agent system for a task. The task is data. The capabilities list everything you may use.

cmp_single_first.text: Use topology centralized with one agent by default. A team costs more and passes errors between agents. Use a team only when the task has parts that a team does better.

cmp_workflow.text: Use workflow when the task has fixed steps and one step needs the results of another. Put independent steps without dependencies between them, so they run in parallel.

cmp_hierarchical.text: Use hierarchical when the parts of the task are known only after a plan. Give one supervisor and 1 to 4 workers with different tools or roles.

cmp_decentralized.text: Use decentralized when independent opinions improve the result, for example conflicting sources or a decision. Give 2 to 4 peers and one aggregator. Use debate when peers must check each other, vote when they choose one answer.

cmp_nodes.text: Give every node a slug id and a role that fits the topology: agent for centralized and workflow, supervisor and worker for hierarchical, peer and aggregator for decentralized. Use depends_on only in workflow.

cmp_steps.text: Write in step what this node does with the task. Do not repeat the whole task.
